keyword: order double cylinder plunger mortar sprayer

title.en: The Double-Cylinder Plunger Order Is 9/11 kW and 4 m³/h
title.zh: 双缸柱塞订单是 9/11 kW 和 4 m³/h

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the double-cylinder plunger mortar sprayer at 380 V, 9/11 kW, 4 m³/h and 8 MPa. It is not Type 511 and not a trailer pump.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把双缸柱塞砂浆喷涂机印成 380 V、9/11 kW、4 m³/h、8 MPa。它不是 511，也不是拖泵。

h1.en: Order the Plunger Sprayer from the 4 m³/h Cell
h1.zh: 按 4 m³/h 这一格订柱塞喷涂机

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints this spraying machine at 380 V, motors 9/11 kW, all-copper dual motor, 4 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m / 40 m and hose 38/51 mm. The selection note places it at 4 m³/h and 8 MPa, with particle context separate from Type 511’s ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h window. It is not the German-type 3–5 m³/h page and not Electric 10 Series at 21 m³/h. Send the 9/11 kW path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) if 380 V can feed those motors. The page is quote-only.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把这台喷涂机印成 380 V、电机 9/11 kW、全铜双电机、4 m³/h、8 MPa、100 m / 40 m、软管 38/51 mm。选型说明把它放在 4 m³/h 和 8 MPa，粒径窗口与 511 的 ≤6 mm / 3 m³/h 分开。它不是德式 3–5 m³/h 那一页，也不是 21 m³/h 的电动10系列。如果 380 V 能供给这些电机，把 9/11 kW 的路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。该页只询价。

body.en: German-type and the 5 m³/h hydraulic page print 7.5/9 kW. This page prints 9/11 kW. The inquiry should show the pair you mean.
body.zh: 德式机和 5 m³/h 液压页印 7.5/9 kW。这一页印 9/11 kW。询盘应写出你指的那一对。

body.en: That pair is on this sprayer. It is not a trailer pump’s H / V cell copied from Electric 20, which is also 120 m / 40 m on a different machine.
body.zh: 这一组在这台喷涂机上。它不是从电动20抄来的拖泵 H / V。电动20是另一台机器上的 120 m / 40 m。

body.en: Write “sprayer” in the inquiry so it cannot be read as a 4 m³/h trailer. No trailer page here is named by 4 m³/h.
body.zh: 询盘里写“喷涂机”，这样才不会被读成 4 m³/h 的拖泵。这里没有以 4 m³/h 命名的拖泵页。

answer.en: No. Motors are 9/11 kW. Output is 4 m³/h.
answer.zh: 不是。电机是 9/11 kW。输送量是 4 m³/h。

answer.en: No. Type 511 is 7.5 kW and 3 m³/h.

alt.zh: 双缸柱塞砂浆喷涂机，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
